description: Permanently delete one bot flow (any type) by ID, together with its buttons and list sections. The bot stops answering its keywords. This cannot be undone — to pause a flow instead, use set_bot_conversation_active with active=false. Call with confirm=false first to get a preview (keywords, buttons, sections) to show the user. Run get_bot_conversations with enabled_only=false to find IDs.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to permanently delete this bot flow.

id.description: ID of the bot flow to delete (from get_bot_conversations)

name: delete_bot_conversation
